sources.title: Fastned: Lucid Air 112 kWh (2023+) and Lucid Gravity 123 kWh (2026+) charge curves
sources.notes: Fastned vehicle pages (model=Air, model=Gravity). Per-percent kW series embedded in the page, measured on Fastned's European network (300-class graph for the Air, 400-class for the Gravity), battery about 30 C. The Air 88 kWh (2024+) and Gravity 89 kWh (2026+) entries have no graph. Same Fastned terms note as src-fastned-tesla-curves-2026 (no reuse clause found; robots allows; owner to confirm).

sources.title: InsideEVs: The Lucid Gravity Touring is here. Here's how fast it charges from 0% to 100%
sources.notes: Published 2025-12-02. Table of power by SoC (0-90 %) with elapsed minutes, 300 kW-capable DC charger, battery preconditioned, 89 kWh rated Gravity Touring. Ambient temperature and test date not stated.

curves.notes: Fastned "Lucid Air 112 kWh (2023+)" curve, 2-95 %, European network, battery near 30 C, peak 305.6 kW at 2 % (1.9 % over the 300 kW rating). Pack 112 kWh matches these Grand Touring ids. InsideEVs 2024 GT test (Moloughney, EA 350 kW) peaked at 319 kW and held >200 kW above 40 %; Fastned holds 203 kW at 40 %, so the shape agrees. The 2025-27 Grand Touring ids list 117 kWh in the spec data and are not covered; the 118 kWh Dream/Sapphire have their own curve. Covered range 2-95 %; outside it the viewer holds the end values, so 0-2 % and 95-100 % are not measured. Fastned labels this entry "2023+", so the 2022 Grand Touring is an assumption (same 112 kWh pack, software unproven). Spec-data oddities: 2023-grand-touring-performance lists gross 112 / usable 109.1 and 2024-grand-touring lists gross 111 / usable 112, so the "112 kWh" pack match is approximate for those two ids.

Fastned "Gravity 123 kWh (2026+)" curve, 400 kW class, 12-87 % only, peak 405.6 kW at 12 % (1.4 % over the 400 kW rating). Conflicts with InsideEVs (Moloughney, 2025, EVgo 350 kW, depleted start): peak 375 kW, over 300 kW until almost 40 % and over 200 kW to nearly 50 %, whereas Fastned is under 300 kW from 26 % and 255 kW at 40 %. The same car on a 250 kW Tesla Supercharger (400 V) peaked ~210-220 kW and held 200+ kW to 42 %. Treat the Fastned curve as conservative above 25 %. Covered range 12-87 % only: 0-12 % and 87-100 % are not measured (the viewer holds the end values, which would show ~405 kW at 0 % and ~77 kW at 100 %). Fastned labels this entry "2026+", so the 2025 Grand Touring is an assumption. Only the 123 kWh gross pack is known (usable unknown), and the Dream Edition has different motors from the Grand Touring; the Fastned page does not distinguish them. No second source agrees with the shape.

InsideEVs Dec 2025 test of the 89 kWh (rated) Gravity Touring, battery preconditioned, charger able to deliver 300 kW; 10 points 0-90 % read from the published table (25 min to 80 %, 34 min to 90 %). 310 kW at 0 % is 3 % above the 300 kW rating (within the 5 % rule). Ambient temperature and test date not stated. No independent second measurement (Fastned has no graph for this pack).
